instruction: Register a new user account on DocShare
input:
URL: https://docshare-app.vercel.app/signup
User is not logged in
DOM Structure:
<form id="signup-form">
  <input id="username-input" type="text" placeholder="Username" />
  <input id="signup-email-input" type="email" placeholder="Email" />
  <input id="signup-password-input" type="password" placeholder="Password" />
  <input id="confirm-password-input" type="password" placeholder="Confirm Password" />
  <input id="terms-checkbox" type="checkbox" />
  <button id="signup-btn" type="submit">Create Account</button>
</form>

Test Intent: Verify user_registration functionality works correctly
output:

page.locator('#username-input').fill('newuser42')

# Fill email

# Fill password

# Confirm password
page.locator('#confirm-password-input').fill('Secure@2024')

# Accept terms
page.locator('#terms-checkbox').check()

# Submit
page.locator('#signup-btn').click()

try:
    page.wait_for_url('**/dashboard', timeout=5000)
    assert 'dashboard' in page.url
except Exception as e:
    console_errors.append(f'Registration failed: ' + str(e))
    raise
